answer: At dawn each epoch the network hands every key one secret share. A share rebuilds a phrase only with one hidden partner share, held by a key the network suspects of being its twin. A bounty is posted for each rebuilt kernel phrase. Strangers cannot tell who holds their partner share, so only an operator running both keys can claim it, and claiming merges those keys into one reward slot. Farms that take the bait expose themselves, and a steady gale of fresh lures each epoch makes the temptation hard to resist forever.
